name: Challenge Deck+
author: Jon
description: Play any challenge on any stake up to Gold, and adds nine new challenges (five Legendary Jokers, Wild Ride, Wild Ride 3X, Magician's Deck, Naneinf). A stake chip on each row of the challenge list lets you pick the stake per challenge - left click cycles up, right click down - and the completion check reflects the highest stake you've beaten that challenge on. Cycling the stake chip is purely cosmetic/bookkeeping - never touches deck wins, joker stickers, stake unlocks or achievements.
